hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the common template g(x)*f(x)**2 by assigning the same variable to x and assigning one unary function to f and another unary function to g for each member.
required_assumptions: f and g are unary function symbols
multiplication is commutative for AC pattern matching
hypotheses.rationale: Both expressions are instances of a unary function of a variable multiplied by the square of another unary function of the same variable; this is the only nontrivial shared structural family observed in the given packets.
